title: Competitive battle card
description: Give sales a one-page answer to a competitor: where they are strong, where we win, objections, questions to ask and claims to avoid, from dated observations.

inputs.label: Competitor or substitute and the deals where it appears
Dated observations from the market dossier and win and loss notes

tool_actions.description: Reviewing the competitor's public pages, pricing and release notes.
Sharing the card in the sales tool.

sections.title: Competitor overview
sections.prompt: Who they sell to, how they price and where we meet them, with the date of each observation.

sections.title: Where they are strong
sections.prompt: What buyers value in their offer, stated fairly.

sections.title: Where we win
sections.prompt: The differences that matter to the buyer, each with proof.

sections.title: Objections and answers
sections.prompt: What prospects say in favour of the competitor and the answer, with its evidence.

sections.title: Questions to ask and claims to avoid
sections.prompt: Discovery questions that bring out our strengths, and statements sales must not make.

checks.verification: Every statement about the competitor cites a market dossier observation or a public source with its date.
Legal confirmed the card makes no disparaging or unverifiable claim about the competitor.
A salesperson used the card in a deal or a rehearsal and their feedback is applied.
